name: How to Plan Your Cabinet Hardware Installation

step.name: Step 1: Select Your Hardware and Confirm Specifications
step.text: Before you do anything else, choose the exact knobs or pulls you want. Once selected, confirm their actual dimensions, especially the center-to-center screw spacing for pulls, as this will dictate your drilling. Ensure the hardware's finish durability and grip comfort align with your expectations for daily use.

step.name: Step 2: Test Placement and Mark Locations
step.text: This is crucial! Don't drill blindly. Using a template or a jig, test out different placements on a spare piece of wood or even on the back of a cabinet door that won’t be visible. For doors, a common placement is a consistent offset near the corner opposite the hinge. For drawers, hardware is often centered, but match it to your door style. Mark your chosen locations precisely.

step.name: Step 3: Prepare for Drilling and Prevent Mistakes
step.text: An awl or pilot hole is your best friend here, preventing the drill bit from wandering and damaging your new cabinet fronts. If you're drilling through delicate materials like veneer, consider using a backer board on the inside to prevent tear-out. Always use the correct screw length to ensure a secure, flush fit without protruding through the cabinet face.

step.name: Step 4: Drill Carefully and Install Securely
step.text: Drill straight through the marked locations, maintaining a steady hand. Once the holes are ready, install the screws and verify that each piece of hardware sits securely and flush against the cabinet surface. Check for any wobbling or misalignment, and make adjustments as needed. A precise, professional installation means everything functions smoothly and looks impeccable.

step.name: Step 5: Inspect and Enjoy Your Refreshed Space
step.text: After all hardware is installed, step back and examine the finished product. Check that all hardware is consistently placed and securely fastened. Wipe down any pencil marks or fingerprints. Then, enjoy the enhanced functionality and updated aesthetic of your cabinets!
